usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing Gotify push-notification endpoint — update its server URL, rotate the secret token, toggle it on/off, or clear optional fields via the `delete` array. Requires `Mapping.Modify` on `/mapping/notifications` plus either `Sys.Modify`/`Sys.Audit` or `Sys.AccessNetwork` on `/`; API tokens are accepted. Pass the `digest` from the current GET response to guard against concurrent edits.

examples.summary: Rotate the Gotify token and re-enable a previously disabled endpoint

tips: Use the `delete` array to unset optional fields (e.g., `"delete": ["comment"]`) rather than passing an empty string.
Always fetch the current endpoint config first (get_gotify_endpoint) to obtain the `digest` before writing — this prevents silent overwrites from concurrent changes.
Disabling via `disable: true` is non-destructive: the endpoint config is preserved and can be re-enabled without reconfiguring server/token.
